sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: The Thompson Center in downtown Chicago has been given a new facade as part of a renovation for tech company Google by architecture studio Jahn. Photos taken earlier this month show the largely complete facade of the Thompson Center, which is in the midst of a complete overhaul by Jahn. Originally designed in the 1980s The post Photos reveal new facade of Google's Thompson Center appeared first on Dezeen .
